title: 1권 7유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble). Scene: A cozy corner of the night garden at dawn, pale pink sky. On a garden bed lies a big lump covered by a colorful patchwork quilt — the friends think the garden queen is sleeping there. Beside it, a black-and-white panda sits drawing with a yellow pencil, and a red cooking pot full of pencils stands next to it with a glowing golden seed inside. Hedgie whispers and points at the panda; Pip is trying to say a sound, but a single round soap bubble floats out of its open beak and it stares at it cross-eyed. Bun covers her mouth laughing. Hidden in the picture: the pencil, the panda, the pot. The lump under the quilt is really Grumble: only his two slippers poke out from under the quilt edge, and a bright warm lantern glow shines through the fabric from inside. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers.
